title: Probability and Statistics
summary: Summaries of data, probability rules, Bayes' theorem and the normal distribution.
objectives: Compute mean, median, variance and standard deviation
Apply Bayes' theorem with base rates
Explain why the median is robust to outliers
socratic_prompts: A test is 90% accurate - why might a positive result still be unlikely to be true?
When would you report the median instead of the mean?

examples.title: Standardisation
examples.code:
import numpy as np
x = np.array([2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9], dtype=float)
print((x - x.mean()) / x.std())
